svg.aria-label: How a run works. Arm A’s front camera, as the agent sees it. 1, See: fixed cameras send pictures, with no positions and no depth. 2, Decide: AI agents split the work and write their own code. 3, Act: one robot tool moves the arms, one command at a time.
